item: Climate tab shows a unit's latest failed fetch attempt beside its last success (row 275)
summary: The unit facts gain a "Last failed attempt" line (date and reason in words) from row 265's last_failure, beside "Last fetched" and never in its place; the kill switch reads as airplane mode; a visible caveat line says the attempt changed nothing stored (or that nothing is stored yet); every server reason token has its own words; 19 strings x12.
